message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts.

Facts: Defendant Li XX, severe disease, wants revenge. On Sep 29 2014, he opened gas stove, intended to cause gas explosion by dialing phone to create spark. Neighbor discovered, called police, closed gas, no explosion. Next day, he went with a knife to a commercial area near a mall, stabbed 20 people, causing various injuries: some heavy, some light, some minor. He was subdued and handed to police. After, police seized his house and froze assets.

Potential charges: Attempted explosion? The list includes "爆炸" (explosion) and "危险物品肇事" (dangerous goods causing accident) and "放火" (arson). He attempted to cause explosion but didn't succeed. The list also has "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" (negligent dangerous method harming public safety) but that's for negligence. Here it's intentional. There's "爆炸" used earlier for case where someone used gas canister etc. That case had "爆炸". So likely "爆炸". Also "故意伤害" for stabbing injuries. Possibly "故意伤害" (intentional injury). The list includes "故意伤害". Also maybe "危害公共安全" but not in list. There's "危险物品肇事" (dangerous goods causing accident). The earlier example: "爆炸" used for case where someone used gas canister and lit it. That was labeled "爆炸". So we use "爆炸". Also "故意伤害". So answer: [罪名]爆炸;故意伤害<eoa>.

Check if any other charges: maybe "非法持有危险物品"? Not in list. "放火" is arson, but he didn't set fire, just attempted explosion. So "爆炸". Also "故意伤害". So final answer.
